----------- changelog -----------

0. Rewrote Alsh for eash of use
1. Fix string buffer growth in dependencies/string.c
   - Avoid reallocating on every add_char()/combine_strings()
   - Implement capacity tracking and exponential reserve
2. Improve shell input handling in dependencies/vega.c
   - Prevent current_line from reallocating on every keystroke
   - Batch write operations and reduce repeated string copies
3. Updated kernel_malloc.s with backward merging in kfree()
    - now coalesces both previous and next free blocks to reduce fragmentation.
    - OOM handling is solid: kmalloc returns NULL on failure, and callers handle 
      it gracefully (e.g., by setting length/capacity to 0).
4. Reduce duplicate copy logic across string/filesystem/alsh
   - Add a memcpy/memmove helper
   - Reuse it in break_args(), create(), combine_strings(), etc.
5. integrate "is_empty_string" check
6. Clean up time/keyboard hardware code
